about_short_description.short_description: Protege is the AI training data platform enabling seamless and compliant data exchange.

product.name: Protege AI Training Data Platform
product.description: A platform for sourcing, licensing, curating, and delivering proprietary real-world datasets for AI model pre-training, post-training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and benchmarking.

identifier.value: Custom AI Dataset Curation and Delivery

product.name: Custom AI Dataset Curation and Delivery
product.description: A managed service that translates model-development requirements into qualified, de-identified, linked, standardized, and purpose-built datasets for training or evaluation.

product.name: Protege Healthcare Data
product.description: A catalog and curation service providing de-identified, multimodal healthcare data for AI development, including EHR, claims, clinical text, imaging, pathology, documents, audio, and genomics.

product.name: Protege Evaluation Datasets and Benchmarks
product.description: Benchmark-specific real-world datasets designed to evaluate healthcare AI models using uncontaminated, representative, and multimodal data from clinical settings.

product.name: Protege Spatial & Physical Intelligence Data
product.description: A collection and curation service for egocentric video, motion capture, 3D scans, digital twins, game data, and physical-interaction data used to develop robotics and world models.

product.name: Protege Video Data Licensing
product.description: A rights-managed service that licenses audiovisual content and prepares it for AI training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and benchmarking while preserving ownership and usage restrictions.
